target_customer: B2B software companies selling into manufacturing, logistics, construction and other traditional industries
problem: Decision makers in legacy sectors are hard to reach with generic outbound tools.
business_model: Managed outbound service, pay per qualified meeting
product_category: Outsourced AI plus human SDR outbound

founders.name: Arnau Ayerbe Garcia
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, led early GPT-2 and BERT systems at JP Morgan.

founders.name: Pablo Jimenez de Parga Ramos
founders.background_notes: YC page says he ran enterprise sales from Seed to Series D; employers not named.

founders.name: Bergen Merey
founders.background_notes: Company blog lists him as a 2023 founder; YC launch post says he built his first online business at 14.

competitors.name: Artisan
competitors.traction_then: Reported about 5M ARR and 120+ customers (secondary source)

competitors.name: 11x
competitors.traction_then: Not verified; disputed metrics reported by a competitor blog
competitors.funding_then: Series B of 50M reported for November 2024

technical_complexity.rationale: Scraping, lead scoring and a power dialer are standard engineering; the service relies on human SDR operations.

defensibility.rationale: Proprietary market databases and multilingual SDR operations help, but agencies are easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Tool vendors serve broad markets while throxy sells a managed service; no incumbent copying throxy specifically was found.

market_need_then: Founders cite that Clay, Apollo and ZoomInfo cover about 65 percent of the market and that outbound to legacy sectors is hard; AI SDR vendors raised heavily in 2024 and 2025.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct, short declarative lines

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch; no merch or fan content found.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive invented name, but no sourced evidence it drove growth.

outcome_analysis: Throxy built a managed outbound business since 2023, reported about 1.5 million dollars of ARR at its September 2025 6.2 million dollar Base10-led seed, and grew to a large team by 2026. The pay-per-meeting model and niche focus on traditional industries are the main drivers; later growth data is limited to company claims.
notes: Seed is confirmed by the company blog and several outlets; GoHub Ventures comes from Nordic 9 and VCBacked. Total funding reports differ (CB Insights 6.7M over 5 rounds, VCBacked and others). CB Insights lists different executives (Yuri Zaremba, Bergen Merey), conflicting with YC. Team size shows 15 in one source and 55 on the YC data. Competitor figures come from secondary sources.
